title: Adopt the mechanism gates into ci.yml (Phase 3.2 and up)
description: As the validators and the kit arrive (migration steps 3.2-3.5), add their gates to this repository's single gate list. No ci.yml exists yet by design: an empty gate list would be a claim without content. One list, per repo - the portfolio ci.yml is the model, not a second enumeration.
